mapper.insert: insert into pev_login_log (stf_no, stf_nm, dept_cd, dept_nm, auth_cd, login_dtm) values (#{stfNo}, #{stfNm}, #{deptCd}, #{deptNm}, #{authCd}, now())
mapper.select: select row_number() over (order by login_dtm) as rowNum, stf_no as stfNo, stf_nm as stfNm, dept_cd as deptCd, dept_nm as deptNm, auth_cd as authCd, to_char(login_dtm, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as loginDtm from pev_login_log where dept_nm != '플랜잇' order by login_dtm desc
select date_trunc('month', login_dtm)::date as weekFromMonday, count(*) as count from pev_login_log where dept_nm != '플랜잇' group by weekFromMonday order by weekFromMonday desc limit 12
select date_trunc('day', login_dtm)::date as day, count(*) as count from pev_login_log where dept_nm != '플랜잇' group by day order by day desc limit 14
select EXTRACT(hour from login_dtm) as hour, count(*) as count from pev_login_log where dept_nm != '플랜잇' group by hour order by hour
select dept_nm as deptNm, count(*) as count from pev_login_log where dept_nm != '플랜잇' group by dept_nm order by count desc
